auth.register.biometricPrompt: Ka tono to kaitirotiro mo te manatoko koiora
auth.register.securityNote: Ka tiakina to putea e to taputapu biometrics. Karekau he mau taviri motuhake ka waiho i to taputapu.
auth.sign.title: Waihangahia to putea
auth.sign.description: Arotakehia o korero me te whakaū
auth.sign.terms: Ma te haere tonu, ka whakaae koe ki ta maatau
auth.sign.cooldown: He maha rawa nga nganatanga. Ngana ano ki roto
auth.sign.redirecting: E anga ana ki te papatohu...

landing.badge: HANGA MO TE piriona e whai ake nei
landing.heroDesc: Nga porowhita penapena penapena i runga i a Stellar. Kore nga takawaenga. Ko te tino rangatiratanga o te putea mo te 1.3 piriona kaore i putea.
landing.feat1Desc: Ka whakamanahia e nga kirimana atamai nga ture katoa. Karekau he kaiwhakarite e taea te rere atu me te puna kaukau. Ia takoha manatoko i runga i te mekameka.
landing.feat2Desc: Ko te tangata he putea Stellar. Kaore he putea putea. Karekau he haki nama. Kore he taitapa.
landing.feat3Title: Rongonui i runga i te mekameka
landing.feat3Desc: Hangaia to MoiScore me nga takoha i ia wa. Te tuakiri putea kawe.
landing.feat4Desc: Ko nga tauwhitinga iti-rau a Stellar ka whai kiko nga porowhita o ia ra. Karekau he utu papaaho hei hanga, hei whakauru ranei.
landing.feat5Desc: Tupurangi, whakaritea, hokohoko, pooti ranei. To porowhita, o ture.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC i tenei ra. He maha atu nga stablecoins i runga i te mahere huarahi.
landing.readyDesc: Waihangahia to porowhita penapena tuatahi i raro i te rua meneti.
